legal.subtitle: Huza abantu, ganira kandi winjize mu mutekano kuri Pesatone.

privacySections.title: 1. Intangiriro
paragraphs: Pesatone yiyemeje kurinda amakuru yawe bwite. Iyi politiki isobanura uko tuyakusanya, tuyakoresha, tuyabika kandi tukayasangiza abandi igihe ukoresha urubuga.
Iyo ukoresha Pesatone uba wemeye iyi politiki. Ibibazo byoherezwe kuri support@pesatone.com.

privacySections.title: 2. Amakuru Dukusanya
paragraphs: Dukusanya amakuru utanga igihe ufungura konti, wishyura, wakira amafaranga cyangwa utwandikira. Ashobora kuba amazina, imeyili, telefoni, ifoto n'amakuru yo kwishyura.
Dushobora no gukusanya amakuru y'igikoresho n'ikoreshwa ry'urubuga nka aderesi ya IP, mushakisha, sisitemu y'igikoresho n'impapuro wasuye.

privacySections.title: 3. Uko Dukoresha Amakuru
paragraphs: Dukoresha amakuru ku mpamvu zemewe zijyanye no gutanga serivisi.

privacySections.title: 4. Gusangiza Amakuru
paragraphs: Ntiducuruza cyangwa ngo dukodeshe amakuru bwite. Dushobora gusangiza amakuru make akenewe abatanga serivisi zo kwishyura no kubika urubuga, abandi bakoresha igihe bikenewe mu bwishyu, cyangwa inzego zibifitiye ububasha iyo amategeko abisabye.

privacySections.title: 5. Umutekano w'Amakuru
paragraphs: Dukoresha uburyo bwa tekiniki n'imiyoborere bukwiye mu kurinda amakuru bwite. Menyesha support@pesatone.com ako kanya niba hari uwakoresheje konti yawe atabyemerewe.

privacySections.title: 6. Kubika Amakuru
paragraphs: Tubika amakuru igihe konti igikora n'igihe akenewe mu gutanga serivisi, kubahiriza amategeko, gukemura amakimbirane no gukumira uburiganya. Ushobora gusaba ko konti isibwa.

privacySections.title: 7. Uburenganzira Bwawe
paragraphs: Hakurikijwe amategeko akureba, ushobora gusaba kubona, gukosora, gusiba, kugabanya cyangwa kwimura amakuru yawe. Andikira support@pesatone.com.

privacySections.title: 8. Cookies
paragraphs: Dukoresha cookies mu kwinjira, kwibuka ururimi, umutekano no gutuma urubuga rukora. Kuzihagarika bishobora gutuma bimwe mu bice bya Pesatone bidakora.

privacySections.title: 9. Ubuzima Bwite bw'Abana
paragraphs: Pesatone ntiyagenewe abatagejeje ku myaka 18. Ntidukusanya nkana amakuru y'abana kandi turayasiba iyo tuyabonye.

privacySections.title: 10. Impinduka kuri Politiki
paragraphs: Dushobora kuvugurura iyi politiki kandi impinduka zikomeye zigatangazwa kuri uru rupapuro. Gukomeza gukoresha urubuga bivuze ko wemeye politiki nshya.

privacySections.title: 11. Twandikire
paragraphs: Ibibazo kuri iyi politiki byoherezwe kuri support@pesatone.com.

termsSections.title: 1. Kwemera Amabwiriza
paragraphs: Iyo ukoresha Pesatone uba wemeye aya mabwiriza. Niba utayemera, ntukoreshe urubuga.
Ugomba kuba ufite nibura imyaka 18 cyangwa wemerewe n'amategeko gukora amasezerano aho uba.

termsSections.title: 2. Konti
paragraphs: Tanga amakuru y'ukuri, hitamo izina rikwiye kandi urinde ijambobanga ryawe. Ni wowe ubazwa ibikorwa bikorewe kuri konti yawe.
Menyesha support@pesatone.com niba konti yakoreshejwe utabyemereye.

termsSections.title: 3. Imikoreshereze Yemewe
paragraphs: Koresha Pesatone mu buryo bwemewe kandi bwubaha abandi. Ntutoteze abantu, ntushyireho ibitemewe cyangwa byangiza, ntuhungabanye serivisi kandi ntushyiremo porogaramu mbi.

termsSections.title: 4. Ubwishyu
paragraphs: Pesatone ifasha abafana guha abahanzi impano. Ibiciro bireba ubwishyu bigaragazwa mbere yo kubwemeza.
Ni wowe ugomba gutanga amakuru y'ubwishyu y'ukuri. Ubwishyu bugengwa kandi n'amabwiriza y'uwabutunganyije.

termsSections.title: 5. Inshingano z'Abahanzi
paragraphs: Abahanzi babazwa ibikubiye mu byo basangiza kandi bagomba kubahiriza amategeko. Umwirondoro n'ibyo bavuga bigomba kuba ukuri.
Pesatone ishobora gukuraho ikiguzi cya serivisi cyabanje kugaragazwa.

termsSections.title: 6. Umutungo mu Bitekerezo
paragraphs: Urubuga, ikirango n'ibikorwa bya Pesatone birinzwe n'amategeko y'umutungo mu bitekerezo.
Ibyo ushyiraho bikomeza kuba ibyawe, ariko wemera ko Pesatone ibikoresha gusa mu gutanga no kunoza serivisi.

termsSections.title: 7. Ubuzima Bwite
paragraphs: Imikoreshereze ya Pesatone igengwa kandi na Politiki y'Ubuzima Bwite isobanura uko amakuru yawe akoreshwa.

termsSections.title: 8. Imbibi z'Inshingano
paragraphs: Pesatone itangwa uko iboneka kandi nta gihamya ko izahora ikora nta kosa. Inshingano zayo zigarukira ku byo amategeko yemera.

termsSections.title: 9. Guhagarika Konti
paragraphs: Dushobora guhagarika konti iyo aya mabwiriza yarenzweho, abandi bakoresha babangamiwe, cyangwa impamvu z'amategeko n'umutekano zibisaba.

termsSections.title: 10. Impinduka
paragraphs: Dushobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza kandi impinduka zikomeye zigatangazwa hano. Gukomeza gukoresha urubuga bivuze ko wemeye amabwiriza mashya.

termsSections.title: 11. Twandikire
paragraphs: Ibibazo kuri aya mabwiriza byoherezwe kuri support@pesatone.com.
